m51.note: Trace the spiral arms from the bright core. Webb picks out thin dust filaments and knots of star formation along the same arms.

m104.note: Look for the dark band across the bright bulge. Webb resolves the outer dust ring into mottled clumps.

m82.note: Start with the bright edge-on disk. In Webb’s image, plumes of gas and dust branch away from both sides.

m42.note: Webb zooms in on the Orion Bar near the Trapezium. Look for the bright ridge where ultraviolet light from young stars meets dense gas.

m33.note: Webb zooms into NGC 604, a stellar nursery in the Triangulum Galaxy. Look for the cavities carved by its young stars.

ngc2392.note: My wide capture shows the nebula as a tiny disk. Webb resolves the white dwarf and the rings and dust clumps around it.

m81.note: Compare how the spiral arms wind outward from a bright core. Webb’s example is the Whirlpool Galaxy.

m63.note: Compare the Sunflower’s patchy spiral with the Phantom Galaxy’s more continuous arms.

m101.note: These face-on spirals make it easy to follow their arms from the core out toward the star-forming regions.

ngc2403.note: Look for clumps of star formation tracing the spiral pattern in both galaxies.

ngc2903.note: Follow the elongated central bar and look where the spiral arms begin at its ends.

ngc891.note: Both galaxies show a dust lane across a nearly edge-on disk. The Sombrero has a much larger central bulge.

m97.note: Both are planetary nebulae. Compare the Owl’s round shell with the rings Webb resolves around the Lion’s central star.

heart.note: Compare the dark cavities and bright gas around groups of young stars.

soul.note: Look at where glowing gas rims the cavities excavated by young stars.

rosette.note: Compare the central cavity and the dusty gas sculpted by the stars around it.

california.note: Follow the boundary where bright ionized gas meets darker clouds. Webb’s example resolves that edge in Carina.

flaming-star.note: Compare the bright folds where starlight meets dense clouds. Webb’s infrared view shows fine structure along the ridge.
